boundary: Browser-hosted AI application builder; Agent mode can directly modify and verify a project. It is not evidence of a portable execution sandbox or customer-owned infrastructure.

prompting_planning: Natural-language task plus constraints; explicit Plan/Agent mode separation; agent explores project context and takes end-to-end ownership in Agent mode.
generated_artifacts: Application source, UI, backend/edge changes, file diffs, verification results, published snapshot; GitHub repository copy when connected.
data_auth_integration: Docs establish project context and GitHub OAuth/app integration; published access is separate from editor access. Exact database, row-security, credential scope, and external integration coverage are not established by the reviewed pages.
ui_design: Visual generation and iterative UI work are documented; exact accessibility and visual-regression guarantees are unknown.
runtime_sandbox: Browser checks and edge-function verification are documented as tools; sandbox isolation, network policy, agent identity, and resource limits are unknown.
deploy_export: Hosted publish and unpublish are documented; GitHub sync supports backup, collaboration, self-hosting and deployment elsewhere. Infrastructure export and backend/auth/secrets export semantics are unknown.
collaboration: Workspace project access, GitHub branches/PRs/reviews, and cross-project references are documented.
recovery: Agent history/checkpoints are referenced, but reviewed sources do not establish a complete source/schema/data restore contract.
governance_security: Workspace admins/owners manage GitHub integration; editor and published-site access are distinct. SSO, tenant isolation, retention, incident process and audit export are unknown.
economics: Agent mode is usage-priced by files, complexity, exploration and tools; message cost is visible. Exact current plan amounts and export costs are unknown.
contradictions: Register called company unresolved; first-party docs identify the Lovable product but the reviewed pages do not settle corporate identity.
